newsitem.title: USA: Summit sees Q2 shr down before charge.
newsitem.headline: Summit sees Q2 shr down before charge.

text.p: Summit Care Corp said on Wednesday that it expects to report net income, before a special charge, of about $1.4 million, or $0.20 a share, for the second quarter that ended December 31, 1996, compared to $2.0 million, or $0.30 a share, the previous second quarter. Summit said it will record a special charge of $2.4 million, or $0.35 a share in its fiscal 1997 second quarter for adjustments recently proposed by Medicare in connection with an audit of fiscal 1995.
Later, a company spokesman clarified that Summit will not have to restate results from previous years and that the adjustment to those years would be handled in the second quarter charge.
